legend: Gross section of a hysterectomy specimen with colpectomy containing a tumour, 6.5 cm in the largest dimension, growing in the posterior wall of the vagina without uterine cervical involvement.

diagnosis: Poorly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma of the vagina
